It's personal now for @WWERomanReigns, but that's exactly what @SamiZayn wants. 😤

@WWEUsos https://t.co/Bwd5cP9QcH

transcript.text: You made this personal, you did. You put yourself on the line of fire of the OTC, you did that.
You want his attention, Sammy, guess what? You got it now. When Raw went off here, when it went off,
he wasn't worried about those 946s. He was worried about you. And he looked me dead in my eyes, Sammy.
And he said at Cradle Jewel, you gonna catch this beat? At Cradle Jewelson, you gonna get your ass beat.
He really said that? Loud and clear. That's great. That's great. That's all I wanted. That's all I
wanted. I wanted him to take this as serious as he needed to take, because that's what I want.
I don't want half of the Tribal Chief. I want the whole thing. I want 100%. I want commitment.
I want him angry. I want him to want to rip my damn heart out of my chest, because that's the respect
that I deserve. I want him waking up thinking about me. I want him going to bed thinking about me.
Tribal Chief says he's going to kick my ass. Good. You tell him the WWE champion will see him then.
